forum.title: How to add X-CUBE-FREERTOS to STM32N657X0HXQ Project
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Cococarbine

Let me thank you for posting.

You need to enable the X-CUBE-FREERTOS package from Software Packs.

![MahmoudBenRomdhane_0-1776938812886.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2a0ac2f6-8cb0-60f5-a5e0-766348b51b46.png "MahmoudBenRomdhane_0-1776938812886.png")![MahmoudBenRomdhane_1-1776938818796.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8ba70e69-068d-bf4b-9154-8e28055b0cf6.png "MahmoudBenRomdhane_1-1776938818796.png")

![MahmoudBenRomdhane_2-1776938865209.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/acc9c96f-5f92-b1b5-1a38-0a9f50857600.png "MahmoudBenRomdhane_2-1776938865209.png")

Thanks.

Mahmoud
forum.content_text:
Hello, I have a simple CubeMX project with the STM32N6 MCU, and I cannot seem to be able to uncheck the FREERTOS option from the FSBL to move it to the Application.  Is there something I am doing wrong?

![Cococarbine_0-1776895369993.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1ab24120-7ecb-2cd6-3a9a-f0933f21f0c6.png "Cococarbine_0-1776895369993.png")

Thank you

You cannot uncheck/check the checkboxes on the lefthand menu.
